name: smwmusic-mega-man-the-wily-wars-wily-tower-stage-2-mega-man
title: Mega Man: The Wily Wars - Wily Tower Stage 2 (Mega Man 7 Mix)
description:
A joyful stage theme used in the second Wily Tower level from Mega Man: The Wily Wars, redone with the instruments and the style of Mega Man 7 for SNES. Could be used in bonus levels.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set.
